position: Improving Access to Employee Stock Ownership Plans
proposal: The Mandate recommends that DOL make it easier for employers to offer employee stock ownership plans by issuing clear regulations on valuation and fiduciary conduct, in a way that encourages employee participation in governance while recognizing the importance of diversification for retirement security. status_summary: EBSA released a proposed adequate-consideration regulation and a proposed prohibited transaction exemption for ESOP transactions on 2025-01-16, scheduled for publication on 2025-01-22, but they were withdrawn under the 2025-01-20 regulatory freeze and were never published. No reissued ESOP valuation or fiduciary rule was found in the Federal Register through 2026-10-13.
